title: Builder inbox and heartbeat activation
summary: The loopback-only command center and Claude Max subscription runtime passed the launch canary. Retrieval Builder and Access Builder are configured, idle, and approval-gated.
evidence: Claude Code uses first-party claude.ai authentication through the existing Max subscription.
No Anthropic API key or metered Anthropic API billing is used.
Each builder has a separate no-remote worktree and read-only sanitized database copy.
Both kickoff issues remain in backlog with a pending human-only confirmation.
No builder heartbeat has run, and production has received zero connections.
The canary preserved task and approval state across restart and passed deterministic usage-limit recovery tests.
limitations: The first orientation reports remain pending human approval. Codex workers and the OpenClaw gateway remain intentionally deferred.
